atrLen = input(14, "ATR Length", 2, 60, 1)
coilLen = input(50, "Coil Length", 10, 120, 1)
vovLen = input(20, "VoV Length", 5, 60, 1)
loadThresh = input(0.75, "Load Threshold", 0.3, 0.95, 0.05)
predLen = input(20, "Predictability Length", 5, 60, 1)
expandMult = input(1.2, "Expansion Mult", 1.0, 3.0, 0.1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

atrV = atr(high, low, close, atrLen)
rangeNow = high - low
rangeMax = highest(rangeNow, coilLen)
atrMax = highest(atrV, coilLen)
rangeRatio = rangeNow / max(rangeMax, 0.0001)
atrRatio = atrV / max(atrMax, 0.0001)
coilRaw = ((1 - rangeRatio) + (1 - atrRatio)) / 2
coilLoad = max(min(coilRaw, 1.0), 0.0)

atrChg = atrV - atrV[1]
vov = stdev(atrChg, vovLen)
vovRising = vov > vov[1]

disp = abs(close - close[predLen])
sumAbs = 0.0
for i = 0 to 19 {
    sumAbs = sumAbs + abs(close[i] - close[i + 1])
}
predRaw = disp / max(sumAbs, 0.0001)
pred = max(min(predRaw, 1.0), 0.0)
predGate = pred >= 0.5

loaded = coilLoad > loadThresh
expansion = rangeNow > rangeNow[1] * expandMult
firstExp = expansion and not expansion[1]
uncoilUp = loaded[1] and not loaded and close > open
uncoilDn = loaded[1] and not loaded and close < open
breakUp = loaded[1] and expansion and not expansion[1] and vovRising and close > open
breakDn = loaded[1] and expansion and not expansion[1] and vovRising and close < open
releaseUp = uncoilUp or breakUp
releaseDn = uncoilDn or breakDn
buySig = (releaseUp or breakUp) and vovRising
sellSig = (releaseDn or breakDn) and vovRising
buyCol = predGate ? "#00ffcc" : "#888899"
sellCol = predGate ? "#ff66ff" : "#888899"
coilPred = coilLoad * pred
predTwin = pred * 0.98 + coilLoad * 0.02

if buySig { plotshape(bar_index, low, "Release Buy", "triangleup", buyCol) }
if sellSig { plotshape(bar_index, high, "Release Sell", "triangledown", sellCol) }
if releaseUp { plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Release Up", "coneup", buyCol, markerSize, 0, "separate") }
if releaseDn { plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Release Dn", "conedown", sellCol, markerSize, 1, "separate") }

plot(coilLoad, "Coil Load", "#22aaff", 2, "separate")
plot(pred, "Predictability", "#ffd43b", 1, "separate")
plot(predTwin, "Pred Twin", "#b48cff", 1, "separate")
hline(loadThresh, "#ff4477", "separate")
plot3d(coilLoad, "Coil Load", "bars3d", "#22aaff", "separate", 0)
plot3d(coilPred, "Loaded Predictable", "scatter", "#ffd43b", "separate", 1)

// Siege MTF Session Range Model
// Session extremes on chart + confirmed 1h structure + quality confidence + hard stop

sessLen = input(20, "Session Length", 10, 100, 1)
structLB = input(2, "Structure Lookback", 1, 10, 1)
confMin = input(60, "Confidence Min", 0, 100, 1)
hardTicks = input(30, "Hard Stop Ticks", 5, 200, 1)

sessHigh = highest(high, sessLen)
sessLow = lowest(low, sessLen)
sessHighPrev = sessHigh[1]
sessLowPrev = sessLow[1]

htfClose = security("1h", close)
htfOpen = security("1h", open)
htfHigh = security("1h", high)
htfLow = security("1h", low)

htfCloseC = htfClose[1]
htfOpenC = htfOpen[1]
htfHighC = htfHigh[1]
htfLowC = htfLow[1]
htfHighRef = htfHigh[1 + structLB]
htfLowRef = htfLow[1 + structLB]

bullStruct = htfCloseC > htfHighRef
bearStruct = htfCloseC < htfLowRef

htfRange = htfHighC - htfLowC
htfBody = abs(htfCloseC - htfOpenC)
quality = htfRange > 0 ? htfBody / htfRange * 100 : 0
conf = quality
confScore = conf / 100
gateOk = conf >= confMin

tickEst = close * 0.0001
stopDist = hardTicks * tickEst

var longPx = 0.0
var shortPx = 0.0
var longStopPx = 0.0
var shortStopPx = 0.0
var posLong = 0.0
var posShort = 0.0

breakHigh = close > sessHighPrev
breakLow = close < sessLowPrev

longState = breakHigh and bullStruct and gateOk and posLong == 0 and posShort == 0
shortState = breakLow and bearStruct and gateOk and posShort == 0 and posLong == 0
buySig = longState and not longState[1]
sellSig = shortState and not shortState[1]

longStopHit = posLong == 1 and low <= longStopPx
shortStopHit = posShort == 1 and high >= shortStopPx
longBreakExit = posLong == 1 and close < sessLowPrev
shortBreakExit = posShort == 1 and close > sessHighPrev
exitLongState = posLong == 1 and (longBreakExit or longStopHit)
exitShortState = posShort == 1 and (shortBreakExit or shortStopHit)
exitLongSig = exitLongState and not exitLongState[1]
exitShortSig = exitShortState and not exitShortState[1]

if buySig {
    model.confidence(confScore)
    model.stopLoss(stopDist, "abs")
    model.longEntry("siege")
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Long", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
    longPx := close
    longStopPx := close - stopDist
    posLong := 1
    posShort := 0
}

if sellSig {
    model.confidence(confScore)
    model.stopLoss(stopDist, "abs")
    model.shortEntry("siege")
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Short", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
    shortPx := close
    shortStopPx := close + stopDist
    posShort := 1
    posLong := 0
}

if exitLongSig {
    model.longExit("siege")
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "ExitL", "diamond", "#ffcc33")
    posLong := 0
    longPx := 0.0
    longStopPx := 0.0
}

if exitShortSig {
    model.shortExit("siege")
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "ExitS", "diamond", "#ffcc33")
    posShort := 0
    shortPx := 0.0
    shortStopPx := 0.0
}

plot(sessHigh, "Session High", "#ff4477", 1, "stepline")
plot(sessLow, "Session Low", "#22cc88", 1, "stepline")

volLen = input(20, "Volatility Length", 5, 50, 1)
momLen = input(12, "Momentum Length", 2, 50, 1)
breakLen = input(20, "Breakout Length", 5, 100, 1)
volMult = input(1.0, "Volatility Multiplier", 0.5, 2.0, 0.1)
momThresh = input(0.0, "Momentum Threshold", 0.0, 10.0, 0.1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)
hhV = highest(high, volLen)
llV = lowest(low, volLen)
vol = (hhV - llV) / close
prevVol = vol[1]
volExpansion = vol > prevVol * volMult
mom = close - close[momLen]
hhB = highest(high, breakLen)
llB = lowest(low, breakLen)
upperBreak = hhB[1]
lowerBreak = llB[1]
negThresh = 0 - momThresh
buySig = crossover(close, upperBreak) and mom > momThresh and volExpansion
sellSig = crossunder(close, lowerBreak) and mom < negThresh and volExpansion
if buySig {
plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if sellSig {
plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}
if buySig {
plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Buy 3D", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, 0, "3d")
}
if sellSig {
plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Sell 3D", "conedown", "#ff4477", markerSize, 1, "3d")
}
if buySig {
alert("Buy Signal")
}
if sellSig {
alert("Sell Signal")
}
plot(upperBreak, "UpperBreak", "#22cc88", 1)
plot(lowerBreak, "LowerBreak", "#ff4477", 1)
plot(vol, "Vol", "#ffaa00", 1, "separate")
plot(mom, "Mom", "#33aaff", 1, "separate")
hline(0, "#888888", "separate")
plot3d(upperBreak, "Upper 3D", "line3d", "#22cc88", "3d", 0)
plot3d(lowerBreak, "Lower 3D", "line3d", "#ff4477", "3d", 1)

lookback = input(80, "Lookback Length", 10, 300, 1)
fibIn1 = input(23.6, "Fib Level 1 %", 1.0, 90.0, 0.1)
fibIn2 = input(38.2, "Fib Level 2 %", 1.0, 90.0, 0.1)
fibIn3 = input(50.0, "Fib Level 3 %", 1.0, 90.0, 0.1)
fibIn4 = input(61.8, "Fib Level 4 %", 1.0, 90.0, 0.1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

swingHigh = highest(high, lookback)
swingLow = lowest(low, lookback)
rng = swingHigh - swingLow

f1 = fibIn1 / 100
f2 = fibIn2 / 100
f3 = fibIn3 / 100
f4 = fibIn4 / 100

fib236 = swingHigh - rng * f1
fib382 = swingHigh - rng * f2
fib50 = swingHigh - rng * f3
fib618 = swingHigh - rng * f4

buySig = crossover(close, fib618)
sellSig = crossunder(close, fib382)

if buySig {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Reclaim 61.8%", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Reclaim 61.8%", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, 3, "3d")
    text.new(bar_index, fib618, "Reclaim 61.8%", "#22cc88", 1, "fibLastEvent")
}
if sellSig {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Lost 38.2%", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Lost 38.2%", "conedown", "#ff4477", markerSize, 1, "3d")
    text.new(bar_index, fib382, "Lost 38.2%", "#ff4477", 1, "fibLastEvent")
}

plot(fib236, "23.6%", "#00ccff", 1, "stepline")
plot(fib382, "38.2%", "#ffcc00", 1, "stepline")
plot(fib50, "50%", "#b48cff", 1, "stepline")
plot(fib618, "61.8%", "#22cc88", 1, "stepline")
plot3d(fib236, "Fib 23.6%", "line3d", "#00ccff", "3d", 0)
plot3d(fib382, "Fib 38.2%", "line3d", "#ffcc00", "3d", 1)
plot3d(fib50, "Fib 50%", "line3d", "#b48cff", "3d", 2)
plot3d(fib618, "Fib 61.8%", "line3d", "#22cc88", "3d", 3)

fastLen = input(10, "Fast Len", 2, 60, 1)
medLen = input(30, "Medium Len", 5, 100, 1)
slowLen = input(60, "Slow Len", 10, 150, 1)
skewLen = input(30, "Skew Len", 5, 100, 1)
compressionLen = input(30, "Compression Len", 5, 100, 1)
expansionMult = input(1.2, "Expansion Mult", 1.0, 2.0, 0.05)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

sqrt252 = sqrt(252)
r = log(close / close[1])
RV_fast = stdev(r, fastLen) * sqrt252
RV_med = stdev(r, medLen) * sqrt252
RV_slow = stdev(r, slowLen) * sqrt252
Hi = highest(high, skewLen)
Lo = lowest(low, skewLen)
rng = Hi - Lo + 0.0000000001
skew = (close - Lo) / rng * 2 - 1
spread_fast_slow = RV_fast - RV_slow
spread_fast_med = RV_fast - RV_med
spread_med_slow = RV_med - RV_slow
compBase = lowest(RV_fast, compressionLen)
compression = RV_fast <= compBase * 1.05
expandTrig = RV_fast > RV_fast[1] * expansionMult and RV_fast > compBase * expansionMult and compression[1]
flipBull = skew[1] <= 0 and skew > 0
flipBear = skew[1] >= 0 and skew < 0
buySig = expandTrig and flipBull
sellSig = expandTrig and flipBear

var lastSigBar = -1000.0
coolOk = bar_index - lastSigBar[1] > compressionLen
buyGated = buySig and coolOk
sellGated = sellSig and coolOk

if buyGated or sellGated {
    lastSigBar := bar_index
}

if buyGated {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}

if sellGated {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}

if buyGated {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Buy 3D", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, 1, "separate")
}

if sellGated {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Sell 3D", "conedown", "#ff4477", markerSize, 1, "separate")
}

impulseSkewed = RV_fast * (1 + skew * 0.15)
plot(spread_fast_slow, "FS Spread", "#33ccff", 1, "separate")
plot(spread_med_slow, "MS Spread", "#ffaa33", 1, "separate")
plot(skew, "Skew", "#cc66ff", 1, "separate")
hline(0, "#888888", "separate")
plot3d(RV_med, "Term Structure", "manifold", "#22cc88", "separate", 0)
plot3d(RV_fast, "Front Spine", "ribbon", "#ffcc33", "separate", 1)
plot3d(impulseSkewed, "Impulse Skew", "bars3d", "#33ccff", "separate", 2)

ch1 = input(20, "Ch1 Strength", 0, 100, 1)
ch2 = input(40, "Ch2 Strength", 0, 100, 1)
ch3 = input(60, "Ch3 Strength", 0, 100, 1)
ch4 = input(80, "Ch4 Strength", 0, 100, 1)
ch5 = input(100, "Ch5 Strength", 0, 100, 1)
thickness_base = input(1, "Spline Base Thickness", 1, 5, 0.5)
thickness_factor = input(0.05, "Spline Thickness Factor", 0, 0.2, 0.01)
buy_threshold = input(70, "Buy Threshold", 0, 100, 1)
sell_threshold = input(30, "Sell Threshold", 0, 100, 1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

chg = close - close[1]
c1v = max(0, min(100, ch1 + chg))
c2v = max(0, min(100, ch2 + chg))
c3v = max(0, min(100, ch3 + chg))
c4v = max(0, min(100, ch4 + chg))
c5v = max(0, min(100, ch5 + chg))
avg = (c1v + c2v + c3v + c4v + c5v) / 5
width = thickness_base + thickness_factor * avg
ascending = c1v < c2v and c2v < c3v and c3v < c4v and c4v < c5v
descending = c1v > c2v and c2v > c3v and c3v > c4v and c4v > c5v
buySig = avg > buy_threshold and avg[1] <= buy_threshold and ascending
sellSig = avg < sell_threshold and avg[1] >= sell_threshold and descending

if buySig {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if sellSig {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}
if buySig {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, avg, "Buy", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, 5, "separate")
}
if sellSig {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, avg, "Sell", "conedown", "#ff4477", markerSize, 5, "separate")
}

plot(c1v, "Ch1", "#33ccff", 1, "separate")
plot(c2v, "Ch2", "#33dd99", 1, "separate")
plot(c3v, "Ch3", "#ffcc33", 1, "separate")
plot(c4v, "Ch4", "#ff8833", 1, "separate")
plot(c5v, "Ch5", "#cc66ff", 1, "separate")
plot(avg, "Array Avg Spline", "#22cc88", width, "separate")
plot3d(c1v, "Cyl Ch1", "bars3d", "#33ccff", "separate", 0)
plot3d(c2v, "Cyl Ch2", "bars3d", "#33dd99", "separate", 1)
plot3d(c3v, "Cyl Ch3", "bars3d", "#ffcc33", "separate", 2)
plot3d(c4v, "Cyl Ch4", "bars3d", "#ff8833", "separate", 3)
plot3d(c5v, "Cyl Ch5", "bars3d", "#cc66ff", "separate", 4)
plot3d(avg, "Top-Face Spline", "ribbon", "#22cc88", "separate", 5)
text.new(bar_index, avg, "Avg", "#ffffff", 12, "avgLabel")

windX = input(1.0, "Wind Dir X", -5.0, 5.0, 0.1)
windY = input(0.0, "Wind Dir Y", -5.0, 5.0, 0.1)
windZ = input(0.0, "Wind Dir Z", -5.0, 5.0, 0.1)
baseSpeed = input(10.0, "Wind Speed Knots", 0.0, 100.0, 0.5)
minSpd = input(0.0, "Min Speed Knots", 0.0, 100.0, 1.0)
maxSpd = input(50.0, "Max Speed Knots", 1.0, 150.0, 1.0)
baseTail = input(1.0, "Base Tail Length", 0.1, 5.0, 0.1)
lenPerKnot = input(0.1, "Length Per Knot", 0.0, 1.0, 0.01)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

drift = close - open
wx = windX + drift * 0.2
wy = windY + drift * 0.15
wz = windZ + drift * 0.1
spd = baseSpeed + drift * 1.5

mag = sqrt(wx * wx + wy * wy + wz * wz) + 0.000000001
nx = wx / mag
ny = wy / mag
nz = wz / mag
horiz = sqrt(wx * wx + wy * wy) + 0.000000001

yDen = wx + 0.0000001
yr = wy / yDen
ayr = yr < 0 ? 0 - yr : yr
ayrInv = 1 / (ayr + 0.0000001)
tYaw = ayr <= 1 ? ayr : ayrInv
tYaw2 = tYaw * tYaw
atanYawT = tYaw * (0.999866 + tYaw2 * (0 - 0.3302995 + tYaw2 * (0.180141 + tYaw2 * (0 - 0.085133 + tYaw2 * 0.0208351))))
atanYawAbs = ayr <= 1 ? atanYawT : 1.5707963 - atanYawT
atanYaw = yr < 0 ? 0 - atanYawAbs : atanYawAbs
yawRad = wx > 0 ? atanYaw : wx < 0 ? (wy >= 0 ? atanYaw + 3.14159265 : atanYaw - 3.14159265) : (wy >= 0 ? 1.5707963 : 0 - 1.5707963)

pr = wz / horiz
apr = pr < 0 ? 0 - pr : pr
aprInv = 1 / (apr + 0.0000001)
tPitch = apr <= 1 ? apr : aprInv
tPitch2 = tPitch * tPitch
atanPitchT = tPitch * (0.999866 + tPitch2 * (0 - 0.3302995 + tPitch2 * (0.180141 + tPitch2 * (0 - 0.085133 + tPitch2 * 0.0208351))))
atanPitchAbs = apr <= 1 ? atanPitchT : 1.5707963 - atanPitchT
pitchRad = pr < 0 ? 0 - atanPitchAbs : atanPitchAbs

yawDeg = yawRad * 57.29578
pitchDeg = pitchRad * 57.29578
rollDeg = 0.0

tailLen = baseTail + lenPerKnot * spd
snRaw = (spd - minSpd) / (maxSpd - minSpd + 0.000000001)
snLow = snRaw < 0 ? 0 : snRaw
speedNorm = snLow > 1 ? 1 : snLow
gradColor = speedNorm < 0.33 ? "#2266ff" : speedNorm < 0.66 ? "#7a6a88" : "#ff8800"
coneSizeRaw = tailLen * markerSize
coneSizeLow = coneSizeRaw < 0.2 ? 0.2 : coneSizeRaw
coneSize = coneSizeLow > 3.0 ? 3.0 : coneSizeLow
yawPrev = yawDeg[1]
yawJump = abs(yawDeg - yawPrev)

buySig = crossover(spd, 20.0) and yawDeg > -45 and yawDeg < 45
sellSig = crossunder(spd, 5.0) or yawJump > 90

if buySig {
  plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Buy", "coneup", "#22cc88", coneSize, 0, "separate", pitchDeg, yawDeg, rollDeg)
}
if sellSig {
  plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Sell", "conedown", "#ff4477", coneSize, 0, "separate", pitchDeg, yawDeg, rollDeg)
}

plot(spd, "Wind Speed kn", "#ff8800", 1, "separate")
plot(tailLen, "Tail Length", "#2266ff", 1, "separate")
plot3d(spd, "Wind Speed", "trail", "#ff8800", "separate", 0)
plot3d(yawDeg, "Yaw Deg", "line3d", "#2266ff", "separate", 1)
plotshape_3d(0, 0, "Wind Arrow", "coneup", gradColor, coneSize, 0, "separate", pitchDeg, yawDeg, rollDeg)

flowSrc = input(close, "Flow PSI Source")
critical = input(150, "Critical Threshold", 10, 300, 1)
spinF = input(1.0, "Spin Factor", 0.1, 5.0, 0.1)
maxR = input(5, "Max Rings", 3, 5, 1)
ringStep = input(1.0, "Ring Expansion Step", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)
textOff = input(2.0, "Text Offset", 0.5, 10.0, 0.5)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

flow_psi = flowSrc
spin_speed = flow_psi * spinF
overState = flow_psi > critical
overStart = overState and not overState[1]
overClear = not overState and overState[1]
discPrice = flow_psi
labelPrice = flow_psi + textOff

var rot = 0.0
var lockState = 0.0
var ringExp = 0.0

if overState {
    lockState := 1
    ringExp := ringExp[1] + ringStep
} else {
    lockState := 0
    rot := rot[1] + spin_speed
    ringExp := 0
}

if overStart {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "OVERPRESSURE", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, discPrice, "Lock", "torus", "#ff4477", markerSize, 0, "separate", 90, rot, 0)
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, discPrice, "Ring1", "torus", "#ff8800", 1.2 * markerSize, 1, "separate", 90, 0, 0)
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, discPrice, "Ring2", "torus", "#ffaa33", 1.6 * markerSize, 2, "separate", 90, 0, 0)
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, discPrice, "Ring3", "torus", "#ffcc66", 2.0 * markerSize, 3, "separate", 90, 0, 0)
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, discPrice, "Ring4", "torus", "#ffeeaa", 2.4 * markerSize, 4, "separate", 90, 0, 0)
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, discPrice, "Ring5", "torus", "#ffffff", 2.8 * markerSize, 5, "separate", 90, 0, 0)
    label3d(bar_index, labelPrice, "OVERPRESSURE", "#ff4477", 2, 6, "separate")
    model.exit("OverExit")
}

if overClear {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Resume", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, discPrice, "Resume", "torus", "#22cc88", markerSize, 0, "separate", 90, rot, 0)
    model.longEntry("Resume")
}

plot(flow_psi, "Flow PSI", "#22aaff", 2, "separate")
plot(spin_speed, "Spin Speed", "#ffaa00", 1, "separate")
hline(critical, "#ff4477", "separate")
plot3d(flow_psi, "Valve Disc", "torus", "#22aaff", "separate", 0)
plot3d(spin_speed, "Spin Trail", "trail", "#ffaa00", "separate", 1)
